newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: IATA clearing house contines to set records.
newsitem.headline: IATA clearing house contines to set records.

text.p: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) said in a statement that it's clearing house settled a new record of $27,995 million in 1996, an increase of eight percent over 1995.

Membership of 269 in 1996 included 195 IATA airlines, 34 non-IATA airlines, 24 airline-owned Companies, eight sponsored airlines and eight special accounts. Total 1996 membership was also a record and a number of airlines have already joined in 1997.
A detailed breakdown was a follows:
* provided by one airline to another, such as engineering and maintenance, aircraft leasing, reservation services, passenger handling, catering and communications.
